page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; marginal notes in the right margin (a column of short references, "Vide etiam" with Exod., Iob, Psal., Isai., 1 Tim., Apoc.). Running head at top with page number 99 and "Cap. 2" at top right. Signature "G 2" at the foot.

main_text.p: Exod. 3. 14. Dixit Deus ad Moyfen; Ego fum QVI SVM. Ait: Sic dices filiis Ifraël; QVI EST misit me ad vos.
Isai. 37. 16. Domine exercituum, Deus Israel, qui sedes super Cherubim, tu es Deus solus omnium regnorum terræ; Tu fecisti cœlum & terram.
Isai. 43. 10. 11. Ante me non est formatus Deus, & post me non erit. Ego sum, ego sum Dominus, & non est absque me Salvator.
Psal. 89. (Hebr. 90.) 2. Priusquam montes fierent, aut formaretur terra, & orbis, à sæculo & usque in sæculum tu es Deus.
main_text.head: 2. Deum esse æternum.
main_text.p: Gen. 21. 33. Abraham invocavit nomen Domini, Dei æterni.Vide etiam Exod. 3. 14. Iob. 36. Psal. 9. (Hebr. 10.) 8. 37. & 39. (Hebr. 90.) 2. Isai. 41. 44. & 43. 10. & 44. 6. & 48. 12. 1. Tim. 1. 17. Apoc. 1. 8.

Psal. 101. (Hebr. 102.) 27. 28. Cœli peribunt; tu autem permanes, & omnes sicut vestimentum veterascent; Et sicut operatorium mutabis eos, & mutabuntur; Tu autem idem ipse es, & anni tui non deficient.
Rom. 16. 26. Evangelium patefactum est per Scripturas Prophetarum secundum præceptum æterni Dei.
main_text.head: 3. Deum esse immensum, vel infinitum.

page.notes: Marginal reference column on the right is printed in small type; its entries are transcribed as one note beside the first paragraph. Catchword "ter-" is a hyphenated line-end word at the foot of the page. Some reference numbers in the margin are doubtful due to the scan quality.
